english_evidence: Official site has a full English version (/en-gb): 'We provide our driving lessons for manual and automatic driving licenses!' and an English owner bio 'Hi! My name is Michael Van Heugten and I have been working as a driving school owner in 's-Hertogenbosch for over 16 years.'
price_signal: Car driving-lesson packages from €1400 (2023 Black Friday promo on English page); losse les pricing not published for this school
waitlist_signal: Positive availability signals: aggregator reviews note 'geen wachttijden' and fastest available CBR exam dates in NL ('Snelste examendata van Nederland'); one review notes the school can be hard to reach by phone
notes: Owner Michael van Heugten; combi-rijschool covering Den Bosch, Tilburg, Oss, Rosmalen and surrounding towns. Categories: B (auto), automaat, AM scooter, A motor, BE/aanhangwagen, taxipas. Conflicting founding/experience signals: Dutch sources and clickdrive say 'ruim/meer dan 23 jaar ervaring' (~2003), English page bio says 'over 16 years' (~2007, page dated 2023), LinkedIn says 'ruim 25 jaar' (~2001), while clickdrive metadata shows '5 jaar ervaring' and KvK 84178426 is a high (recent ~2021) number suggesting a re-registration of an older operation. Founding_year=2003 derived from the most consistent '23 jaar ervaring' claim. English_instruction=likely: the site is fully translated to English (single strong website signal) but no explicit 'lessen in het Engels' statement and no English-language learner reviews were found. Do NOT confuse with the unrelated 'Rijschool van Heugten' (rijschoolvanheugten.nl, instructor Hans, €2399 package) or 'Autorijschool Van Heugten' (Deken van Roestellaan 47, tel 073-5216705) which are different Rosmalen schools.
